Circuitous FX browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Circuitous FX FZ-BRK Published on September 11, 2024 Circuitous FX fuzz pedal Information Circuitous FX Two years in the making, the FZ-BRK is a CMOS (sea moss!) fuzz effect designed to defy convention. This pedal is not intended to give you beautiful guitar tones that adjust dynamically with your guitar's volume. It is brutal, compressed, fuzzy, and robotic. This pedal is perfect if you want gritty, glitchy square wave sounds that are unlike any other effect. Why LEGO ? You can't go anywhere in our house or studio where you can't find LEGO bricks. We build and play with them every day. It seemed only natural to build some pedals with them.
